kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أستعصم (form X)
# أَسْتَعْصِمُ (ʔastaʕṣimu) /ʔas.taʕ.sˤi.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَعْصَمَ (istaʕṣama)
# أَسْتَعْصِمَ (ʔastaʕṣima) /ʔas.taʕ.sˤi.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَعْصَمَ (istaʕṣama)
# أَسْتَعْصِمْ (ʔastaʕṣim) /ʔas.taʕ.sˤim/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَعْصَمَ (istaʕṣama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
